# A payment of INV-USD-001 stating the "Money in" transaction, and a split guid
# no split of that transaction has.
#
# `txn_guid:` states the transaction from money_booked_to_a_cad_account.txt.
# `txn_split_guid:` states 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef, which is neither of
# its two splits, so nothing says which split settles the invoice.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing. The import refuses the invoice.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
invoice "INV-USD-001"
  customer_id: "C-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-05
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-05
    description: "Consulting"
    action: "Hours"
    account: "Income:Sales"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-05
    due: 2026-02-05
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
    memo: "Invoice INV-USD-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-02-25
    amount: 100
    account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
    txn_guid: "c9f27c2b2f324117aa17c7c1f48fbafd"
    txn_split_guid: "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
